initial_query: I am looking for a hotel building. I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA). I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near healthcare services.
submitted_query: I am looking for a hotel building. I intend to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA). I prefer a property in energy class D or better. I prefer properties near healthcare services.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Bar, ristoranti, sale da ballo e assimilabili'
  )
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 75
ORDER BY
  id ASC

requirements.description: The user wants a hotel to convert into a residential senior care facility (RSA) and prefers properties near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics). 'Near' is a proximity expression, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06, rounded to 75).
The user prefers an energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Proximity to healthcare services is a geographic requirement and is out of scope, so it is not included.
